summary: Iter407: Admin Close (Cierre Administrativo) on all quotes + admin-only Referente reassignment for Initial Contacts. Backend 7/7 pytest pass (reassign: 403 non-admin, 400 same ref, 400 unknown ref, 404 contact, 200 with referente_id/referred_by updated + bitacora action referente_reassigned incl. comment; admin-close: catalog contains admin_close 'Cierre Administrativo', non-admin 403 on check+post, check eligible=true, reason<10 -> 400, close OK -> removed from GET /api/quotes, present in /api/quote-history (quote_status_final='Cierre Administrativo', admin_closure.reason), check eligible=false afterwards and 2nd close -> 400, .exe support -> 400 without closing, 404 unknown quote; override implementacion_pyme|vpos|admin_close with allowed_user_ids authorizes non-admin (200) and enabled=false denies (403)). UI verified: Contactos Iniciales reassign button -> dialog shows current referente, current referente excluded from picker, confirm disabled until pick, toast 'Referente reasignado', grid shows new referente. Cotizaciones: admin-close item present in action menu, dialog confirm disabled for empty/5 chars, enabled at 10+, toast, quote leaves grid (~2s, after re-fetch) and stays gone after reload; Histórico shows CIERRE ADMINISTRATIVO badge with reason/closer tooltip. Override de Acciones tab lists 'Cierre Administrativo'. All test data created by me (TEST_ quotes, contacts, overrides, a TEST_ non-admin user) was deleted by id; no real quote/contact touched.

minor.issue: Not atomic: quote_status is set to 'Cierre Administrativo' + status_history pushed BEFORE archive_quote_to_history; if archiving throws, API returns 500 but the quote stays in Cotizaciones with status 'Cierre Administrativo' and archived=false (eligible again, duplicate status_history on retry).

Admin always authorized even when the admin_close override is enabled=false (UI hides the item for admin via meta.hidden, but backend still accepts). Decide whether 'desactivar' should also apply to admins; currently UI/backend are inconsistent.
Does not validate referente estatus (inactive referente accepted by API; only the UI filters estatus!==false).

ui_bugs.issue: Preliminary quotes (quote_number starting 'PRE-', e.g. PRE-2026-11-0008-PYME) render a separate reduced menu (assign client/modify/send email) without admin-close-btn, although requirement says 'TODAS las cotizaciones' and backend allows closing them.

issues: Referido por badge (e.g. 'ANTONIO CASTRO') wraps onto two lines with split pill background - looks broken; use whitespace-nowrap or allow pill to wrap as block.
Desde/Hasta use native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar (pre-existing).
Responsable column shows '—' for quotes created via API by QA admin (created_by_name not resolved) - pre-existing.

action_items: Make admin-close robust: archive first (or roll back quote_status on archive failure)
Decide/align whether a disabled admin_close override also blocks admins (backend vs UI)
Optionally expose Cierre Administrativo in the PRE- (preliminary) quote menu to meet 'todas las cotizaciones'
Validate referente estatus in reassign endpoint
Fix wrapping of referente badge in Contacto Inicial grid
